rationale: The eight existing v4 theorem targets are valid and must remain unchanged, but the explicit bit-bucket no-op obligation from v3 was accidentally dropped. Restore it as its own full proof-plan-visible declaration: theorem OrB32_OrB32Step_bitBucket_noop (s : MachineState) (i : OrB32Instruction) (s' : MachineState) (h : OrB32Step s i s') (hd : i.d = Destination.bitBucket) : s' = s. Attribute it only to architecture D-2/D-6 and AMB-OR-2, explicitly noting it is a project design property rather than an or.b32-specific NVIDIA fact. Preserve all eight existing theorem declarations exactly, add this as the ninth target, add no proofs, and have the critic verify that proof-plan extracts exactly nine complete declarations.
